description: Set the tenant's hourly and daily rate in CHF used for savings (stundensatz_chf, tagessatz_chf; optional notiz). Appended with person and timestamp, the latest wins; applies to new estimates. Without a row the default (90 CHF/h, 960 CHF/day) is used and marked as default. Admins (humans) only — never set by an AI.

stundensatz_chf.description: Hourly rate in CHF used for savings

tagessatz_chf.description: Daily rate in CHF used for savings
